study: Known-rule and frozen transfer controls for signed token parity
positive_control: Exact public induction rule implemented from raw tokens, independent of generator indices: latest earlier equal character, then take its successor.
negative_control: Always take the nearest earlier admissible successor position, independent of token identity.
learned_models: Frozen parity endpoints of the previously released successor-key and same-position-key models. Preserve fit checksums. No parameter/temperature selection or access to indices at inference.
query: Per seed produce 2048 no-repeat four-character sequences by iid uniform transitions, retain the length-98 prefix and length-196 whole sequence. At each length, choose a query uniformly among positions in the latter half with at least seven valid hops. Query is paired across models and both depths; lengths share prefixes, with distinct sampled queries.
primary: Frozen successor-model exact complete-path accuracy on the length-196, seven-hop condition, reporting counts and the five paired per-fit values; known-rule comparator receives the true rule without training.
secondary: Full 2x2 grid, realized public-sign parity error, expected error for independent sign draws, recency-only and unshifted control. No general claim for new alphabet, architecture or task rule.
